C_SeraKade.name: Dr. Sera Kade
C_SeraKade.visualAnchor: Woman in her early 50s, compact build, medium-brown skin, short tightly curled dark hair threaded with gray, alert dark eyes, thin scar through the left eyebrow. Calm survey-physicist presence rather than ceremonial authority.
C_SeraKade.wardrobe: Rex Fleet Academy instructor uniform in blue, white, and restrained gold; practical sleeves, no ornate command cape or Crown-specific regalia.
C_SeraKade.performance: Dry, patient, exact. She teaches by asking students to commit to an answer, then making them live with its consequences.
promptContinuity: Keep the eyebrow scar and short gray-threaded curls consistent
Instructor, not admiral; authority comes from attention and experience

C_TomasRhee.name: Cadet Tomas Rhee
C_TomasRhee.visualAnchor: Korean-descended man, 20, lean athletic build, straight black hair kept short at the sides, expressive brows, quick hands and restless posture.
C_TomasRhee.wardrobe: Blue-white Academy flight cadet uniform with gold piping, soft training harness when aboard the cutter.
C_TomasRhee.performance: Fast, confident pilot instincts; hates hesitation and initially treats navigation as a problem of keeping the ship centered on the visible route.
promptContinuity: Physical confidence should soften into concentration rather than humiliation when corrected

C_MiraSen.name: Cadet Mira Sen
C_MiraSen.visualAnchor: South Asian woman, 21, slim build, warm-brown skin, long black hair braided tightly down the back, narrow rectangular data lenses often pushed up on her head when she wants to look directly at someone.
C_MiraSen.wardrobe: Blue-white Academy navigator uniform with gold trim; compact wrist slate and plotting stylus.
C_MiraSen.performance: Quiet until she has a model she trusts; notices relationships and gradients before objects.
promptContinuity: Braided hair and rectangular data lenses remain consistent

C_JoVale.name: Cadet Jo Vale
C_JoVale.visualAnchor: White nonbinary cadet, 20, stocky build, pale freckled skin, copper buzz cut, round face, heavy utility watch on the left wrist.
C_JoVale.wardrobe: Academy systems uniform with blue-white base, gold rank piping, small diagnostic kit clipped at the hip.
C_JoVale.performance: Blunt systems thinker; separates what an instrument measured from what people assume the measurement means.
promptContinuity: Copper buzz cut, freckles, utility watch on left wrist

C_KellanAru.name: Cadet Kellan Aru
C_KellanAru.visualAnchor: Black man, 22, broad-shouldered and tall, close-cropped hair, square jaw, grease permanently worked into the creases of his hands despite Academy grooming standards.
C_KellanAru.wardrobe: Academy engineering uniform worn slightly looser than regulation, blue-white with gold piping; tool gloves tucked through belt when not in use.
C_KellanAru.performance: Mechanic's skepticism. Trusts loads, vibration, heat, and what the hull is physically doing.
promptContinuity: Grease-marked hands are a recurring visual detail

C_RennOris.name: Lt. Renn Oris
C_RennOris.visualAnchor: Man in his late 30s, olive skin, shaved head, narrow mustache, rangy build, watchful gray-green eyes.
C_RennOris.wardrobe: Rex Fleet Academy training-officer uniform, blue and white with modest gold rank bars; safety harness aboard training craft.
C_RennOris.performance: Operationally conservative. He protects the training envelope while letting Kade's lesson remain genuinely uncertain.
promptContinuity: Never reads as reckless or secretly sabotaging the exercise
